text:
Dana Ortiz: Heads-up 1 0  - on my phone the Day 1 invite shows a tiny preview that says 'Join (cloud)'. Tapping it opens a webview that asks for a Zoom passcode. Anyone else hit that?
Miguel Alvarez: Yep saw that yesterday. Mobile webview sometimes can't handle the redirect to our S3 presigned link so it falls back to the Zoom cloud page which may require passcode.
Dana Ortiz: That feels like a bad UX for mobile-only folks. Could the ICS include a direct short link to the S3 presigned URL or at least note where the recording will be posted?
Onboard Bot: @channel Recording flow reminder: Zoom -> processed -> uploaded to onboarding S3 -> presigned link posted in #new-hires (~15-45m) -> archived to onboarding Drive/Notion within 48h. Presigned links expire in 7 days.
Calendar Team: We're planning to add a small 'Recording landing: #new-hires (S3/Notion/Drive)' line to the ICS export. That should help mobile previews show explicit text. Patch scheduled tonight.
Mobile Dev: For mobile webview passcodes we can do two things: 1) include a short static URL in the ICS that redirects server-side to the current presigned link (no client redirect needed), or 2) embed the passcode in a secure one-time token flow. Option 1 is simpler.
Miguel Alvarez: Option 1 sounds perfect. Any privacy concerns with a static redirect URL?
Mobile Dev: It's safe if the redirect URL checks a short token and only issues the presigned link; the token can be rotated. We avoid putting the S3 URL itself in the ICS because of expiry and token leakage.
Dana Ortiz: Awesome. Also another small issue: my calendar client created an all-day "Onboarding" placeholder and a timed event. On mobile the placeholder shows on top of my day. How should I handle that?
Calendar Team: Decline the placeholder and uncheck "send response" to avoid notifying hosts. We're pushing a fix to the exporter so placeholders are only visible to admins.
Miguel Alvarez: Final question: if I watch the recording via the mobile preview but it's captioned, where does the VTT live?
Onboard Bot: Captions: VTT transcript posted alongside the presigned S3 link in the thread. Both MP4+VTT are archived to Drive/Notion within 48h.
Dana Ortiz: Thanks everyone 44d. Ping me when the ICS patch is live and I'll test on iOS and Android.
